description: List estimates with number, status, line items, subtotal, tax, total, margin, e-sign state and related job/contact. Returns {count, results}; count is the account total. JobNimbus: GET /v2/estimates.

from.description: Zero-based offset for pagination (default 0). Next page: from + size.

size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Defaults to 25 here (the API's own default is 1000).

name: jobnimbus_list_estimates
title: List estimates
